thread:
ana (CSE): Heads-up — Northbridge onboarding: summarize endpoint p95 ~2.1s, customer flagged for renewal sensitivity.
ty (SRE): Hosted infra? which model variant and token distribution? :mag:
vik (ML Eng): Hosted on redwood-open-xl-v1, heavy long-doc tail (2.5k-4k tokens). KV cache miss rate high on nightly jobs.
ana (CSE): They sent examples; several have large repeated headers which we could cache.
noah (AE): Customer wants latency improvement first; cost reduction is secondary but important for renewal talks.
vik (ML Eng): Suggested experiment:
- Enable route-level prefix KV cache (TTL 10-24h) for their summarize route.
- Canary a quantized build (v1-int8) at 8% traffic scoped to northbridge.
- For docs > 2600 tokens, route to redwood-compact-xl-qa with a small prompt shim.
ty (SRE): I can implement the cache and add routing rule: if input_tokens > 2600 && customer=="northbridge" -> compact model (canary 10%). I'll also scope int8 canary policy.
ops-bot: deploy queued: canary redwood-open-xl-v1-int8 -> 8% via policy "northbridge-int8-pilot".
vik (ML Eng): We'll run a 18-sample eval set. Baseline quick summary:
```
float p95 2100ms ROUGE-L 0.74
int8 p95 1150ms ROUGE-L 0.737
compact p95 920ms ROUGE-L 0.706
```
Quality drop minimal; latency wins solid.
ana (CSE): Drafting a short customer note: "pilot to reduce tail latency and cost: int8 canary + selective routing of very long docs to compact model. We'll monitor quality and rollback if needed." OK? :+1:
noah (AE): Good. I'll schedule a 25m call and ask for 24-48h acceptance tests and their 10 sample docs. Will mention a renewal incentive if pilot is successful.
vik (ML Eng): Rollback plan: canary -> 0%, remove routing rule. Alert on ROUGE-L delta >1.2% -> notify @vik @ana.
ty (SRE): Ops checklist:
- [x] Prefix KV cache enabled (TTL=12h)
- [x] Int8 canary policy created (8%)
- [x] Routing rule staged (10% compact route)
- [ ] Monitoring dashboard (latency/cost/ROUGE) - ETA EOD
ops-bot: alert created: northbridge-canary-quality -> notify @vik @ana on ROUGE-L drop >1.0%
